modules.reason: The runtime of the Go code that protoc-gen-go generates from the protobuf schema in api/proto (decisions 0090 and 0132).
The runtime of the Connect code that protoc-gen-connect-go generates for the services in api/proto, which embedded mode calls in-process and remote mode over the network (decision 0152).
Runs the workflow's state machine, with superstates, one internal trigger for each transition, no guards and the state kept outside the machine (decisions 0018 and 0169).
Reads the workflow file in protobuf text format with prototext and finds its output messages in the api module's descriptors (decisions 0167 and 0168).
Validates and authorizes each Cedar request at runtime (decision 0146); its tests parse and resolve the Cedar schema of the api module (decision 0141).
Writes and reads each line of the embedded log as the protojson of the CloudEvent message (decision 0157).
LockFileEx in golang.org/x/sys/windows locks the embedded log on Windows, where the standard library has no public file lock (decision 0157).
Serves ControlPlaneService with the generated Connect handlers, in-process and over HTTP, and the conformance suite calls it through the generated clients (decisions 0152 and 0161).
Copies the invocation document into the harness invocation and reads and writes the adapter's protojson (decisions 0158 and 0160).
Reads the code of a failed call of RunnerService, to tell a control plane that cannot be reached from a lease that is not current (decision 0205). The generated RunnerService client already links it.
The golden case runner in the tests of cmd/pumi reads each case's events as protojson, normalizes the values that differ on every run and compares the events with proto.Equal (decision 0183).
